title: SearchWriteResult
description: search.write-result@1: the answer of PUT /api/v1/documents/:owner/:type/:id (search.document.write). applied: stored (or a tombstone recorded); unchanged: the same revision with the same content. A revision older than the stored one is a 409 problem search.stale_revision; the same revision with different content is 409 search.revision_conflict.

stored_revision.description: What Search held before this write (null: nothing).
